summary: Master urban planning for smart cities and resilient infrastructure. Learn QGIS, IoT, and climate resilience strategies. Enroll now for 5-day intermediate train
lede: Smart city planning and urban resilience bring geospatial data, infrastructure needs and climate considerations into coordinated decisions. For professionals who plan, finance, design or manage urban systems, this course covers assessing city needs and turning data into practical plans. Learners map hazards and hotspots with GIS, analyze mobility and housing indicators, and design IoT integration strategies and resilience dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, finance, design, deliver, or manage urban systems and must integrate climate resilience and smart technologies into their operations.
modules: Foundations of Smart City Strategy and Urban Resilience
Geospatial Technology and Urban Data Analytics
Housing Intelligence and Land Use Planning
IoT-Enabled Smart Infrastructure and Utility Management
Climate Resilience and Sustainability Data Integration
Social Equity, Stakeholder Engagement, and Regulatory Compliance
Executive Dashboards and Strategic Urban Reporting
Integration Strategy and Multi-Year Resilience Roadmap
Emerging Technologies and Future Urban Trends
Capstone: Comprehensive Smart City and Resilience Proposal
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic urban planning concepts. No coding or advanced technical skills are required. Bring a laptop for hands-on labs using QGIS and Power BI. All datasets and software are provided during the course.
